spanish: Desde moradas de ustedes traerán pan de balanceo, dos; dos décimos sólet serán; leudado serán horneadas; primicias a Jehová.

findings.issue: Common noun סֹלֶת (H5560, singular) is left as the untranslated lemma sólet; common nouns stay Spanish.

notes: Remaining clauses match the packet’s participants, number, and stem, including ustedes for 2mp and Jehová for יהוה.
